# Natura Bliss

> 100% Pure Extra-Virgin Cold-Pressed Oils, Herbal Haircare & Organic Skincare in Pakistan.

Natura Bliss is a Pakistani organic wellness and beauty brand headquartered in Chakwal, Punjab. The brand specializes in traditional cold-pressing extraction of seed and nut oils, artisan herbal soaps, sulphate-free shampoos, and natural brightening skincare.

## Core Product Categories & Offerings

### 1. Pure Cold-Pressed Oils
- **Extraction Method:** Cold-pressed extra-virgin, unrefined, zero mineral oils, zero hexane, zero heat damage.
- **Key Products:**
  - Coconut Oil (Hair & Body)
  - Sweet Almond Oil (Skin & Hair)
  - Castor Oil (Lashes, Brows & Hair Growth)
  - Sesame Oil (Deep Nourishment)
  - Blackseed (Kalonji) Oil (Therapeutic & Hair Vitality)
  - Pumpkin Seed Oil (Dht-Blocker & Scalp Health)
  - Onion Seed Oil (Anti-Hairfall)
  - Rosemary Essential Infused Oil (Scalp Circulation)
  - Pure Extra Virgin Olive Oil

### 2. Herbal Haircare
- **Herbal Shampoo:** Sulfate-free botanical cleanser enriched with Shikakai, Amla, and Reetha.
- **Kre-Bio Shampoo + Conditioner:** Complete anti-breakage hair therapy.
- **Onion Hair Oil & 804 Serum:** Concentrated natural hair growth boosters.

### 3. Organic Handmade Soaps
- **Neem Soap:** Clarifying antibacterial bath bar for acne-prone skin.
- **Rice Soap:** Gentle exfoliating and complexion brightening bar.
- **Charcoal Soap:** Activated bamboo charcoal for deep pore cleansing.

### 4. Gluta Radiance Skincare
- **Gluta Fair Night Cream:** Gentle botanical glow formula.
- **Gluta Care Body Lotion:** Lightweight hydrating daily lotion.
- **Gluta Facial Wash:** Refreshing daily face wash.
- **No Frac Night Cream:** Targeted evening restoration treatment.

### 5. Farm-Fresh Organic Nutrition
- **Pure Desi Ghee:** Grass-fed traditional Pakistani clarified butter.
- **Wild Forest Honey:** 100% raw, unheated, unfiltered bee honey.

## Delivery & Orders in Pakistan
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available nationwide on all orders.
- **Shipping Coverage:** All cities in Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Quetta, and rural districts.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 2 to 4 business days via courier.
- **Currency:** Pakistani Rupee (PKR / ₨).
- **Return Policy:** 7-day exchange or refund for defective or damaged items.
